description.en: On-device Vietnamese/English TTS (48 kHz) with instant voice cloning from 3-5 s of reference audio, by Phạm Nguyễn Ngọc Bảo (pnnbao97). Takes SEA-G2P phonemes as text input.
description.zh: 面向设备的越南语/英语 TTS（48 kHz），可用 3–5 秒参考音频即时克隆音色，作者 Phạm Nguyễn Ngọc Bảo（pnnbao97）。文本输入采用 SEA-G2P 音素。

auto_frame_cap.en: Cap the generation budget using the chunk's phoneme count. Legacy frame_cap remains accepted.
auto_frame_cap.zh: 按分块音素数量限制生成预算。仍接受旧字段 frame_cap。

text_chunk_min_size.en: Phoneme-string chunks shorter than this character count join a neighbour. Legacy text_chunk_min remains accepted.
text_chunk_min_size.zh: 音素字符串分块短于该字符数时并入相邻分块。仍接受旧字段 text_chunk_min。

speaker_embedding_file.en: File containing a comma-separated 192-dimensional speaker embedding.
speaker_embedding_file.zh: 包含逗号分隔的 192 维说话人嵌入的文件。

speaker_embedding.zh: 内联的逗号分隔 192 维说话人嵌入。

reference_codes.en: Pre-encoded reference codes in row-major order, comma- or space-separated; codebooks per frame come from the checkpoint.
reference_codes.zh: 预编码参考 code，按行优先、逗号或空格分隔；每帧 codebook 数由检查点决定。

reference_codes_file.en: Pre-encoded reference codes, one frame per line. Replaces audio encoding and can be used with a speaker embedding instead of reference audio.
reference_codes_file.zh: 预编码参考 code，每行一帧。替代音频编码，可与说话人嵌入一起使用。

x_vector_only_mode.en: Clone using only the speaker embedding. Defaults to true for embedding-only input, otherwise false.
x_vector_only_mode.zh: 仅使用说话人嵌入克隆。仅嵌入输入时默认 true，否则 false。

encode_reference_only.en: Encode reference audio and return an acoustic-tokens artifact without generating speech.
encode_reference_only.zh: 编码参考音频并返回声学 token 产物，不生成语音。

max_tokens.en: Maximum generated frames per text chunk; uses the checkpoint max_new_tokens setting (300 fallback). Each frame represents 80 ms.
max_tokens.zh: 每个文本分块生成的最大帧数；使用检查点 max_new_tokens 设置（回退 300）。每帧表示 80 ms。

do_sample.en: Enable sampling for all codebooks unless subtalker_do_sample overrides later codebooks.
do_sample.zh: 为所有 codebook 启用采样，除非后续 codebook 被 subtalker_do_sample 覆盖。

temperature.en: Sampling temperature for all codebooks unless overridden for the subtalker.
temperature.zh: 所有 codebook 的采样温度，除非 subtalker 覆盖。

top_k.en: Top-k sampling limit for all codebooks unless overridden for the subtalker.
top_k.zh: 所有 codebook 的 top-k 采样上限，除非 subtalker 覆盖。

top_p.en: Nucleus cutoff within top-k candidates, unless overridden for the subtalker.
top_p.zh: top-k 候选内的核采样截断，除非 subtalker 覆盖。

repetition_penalty.en: Repetition penalty applied independently to each codebook.
repetition_penalty.zh: 对每个 codebook 独立应用的重复惩罚。

repetition_window.en: Recent frames remembered per codebook for repetition penalties; zero uses all history.
repetition_window.zh: 每个 codebook 为重复惩罚记住的最近帧数；0 使用全部历史。

babble_retries.en: Regenerations for short chunks that exceed their text; zero disables the guard.
babble_retries.zh: 对超出文本长度的短分块重新生成次数；0 关闭该保护。

subtalker_temperature.en: Temperature override for later codebooks; omitted or negative inherits temperature.
subtalker_temperature.zh: 后续 codebook 的温度覆盖；省略或负值继承 temperature。

subtalker_top_k.en: Top-k override for later codebooks; omitted or negative inherits top_k.
subtalker_top_k.zh: 后续 codebook 的 top-k 覆盖；省略或负值继承 top_k。

subtalker_top_p.en: Nucleus cutoff override for later codebooks; omitted or negative inherits top_p.
subtalker_top_p.zh: 后续 codebook 的核采样截断覆盖；省略或负值继承 top_p。

subtalker_do_sample.en: Sampling override for later codebooks; inherits do_sample when omitted.
subtalker_do_sample.zh: 后续 codebook 的采样覆盖；省略时继承 do_sample。

seed.en: Sampling seed; omitted draws a random seed.
seed.zh: 采样随机种子；省略时随机抽取。

text_chunk_size.en: Maximum character budget per phoneme-string chunk; must be positive.
text_chunk_size.zh: 每个音素字符串分块的最大字符预算；必须为正。
